The structure of composition Tl4Hg8I24 (reduced formula Tl(HgI3)2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 36 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral environments for both Hg and Tl, each with six I neighbors, while each I center has two geometric neighbors, one Hg and one Tl. The Hg and Tl octahedra are connected through corner-sharing, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
